# Greek IPTV — greek-video.net

> Greek IPTV is a premium Greek IPTV streaming service offering 50,000+ live
> Greek and international TV channels in HD and 4K, plus 200,000+ movies and
> series on demand. Instant activation, no contract, and 24/7 support in
> Greek via WhatsApp. Serves viewers in Greece, Cyprus and the Greek diaspora
> worldwide.

## Key facts
- Brand: Greek IPTV (greek-video.net)

- Sports: Super League, Champions League, Europa League, NBA and 3,000+ sports channels

- Devices: Smart TV, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Android TV, Fire TV / Firestick, MAG & Formuler boxes, mobile, tablet
- Activation: under 5 minutes after order
- Contract: none; cancel anytime
- Support: 24/7 in Greek via WhatsApp
